title: Robert M NDE 1038
content:
Admitted to the emergency room with chest pain. Treated with clot busting medicine for blockage in vessel feeding the bottom of my heart determined by electrocardiograph. After ninety minutes, I said to the doctor, 'Boy, do I feel dizzy!' I immediately blacked out, and I felt like I sank through the bottom of the stretcher into water. I had the feeling I was flailing my arms to swim back to the surface. I was panicking, fighting for my life (while arguing with myself to let go). Suddenly I am standing twenty feet away from the stretcher watching the doctor perform CPR on my body. During his time, I was very calm, and noticed I was only a consciousness, no body, no pain, no problems, no worries. It was great! As I watched the doctor perform compressions on my chest I thought, I don't feel anything, this guy can't control whether I live or die. I thought only I can control whether live or die. As soon as I had this thought I was back in my body, and awake.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes Heart attack Life threatening event, but not clinical death Heart attack.
elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: Yes I was just a seeing consciousness. No form.
elements.At what time during the experience were: I felt as though I was fully conscious, and alert.
elements.Did your hearing differ in any way from: I do not remember hearing anything.
elements.Did you suddenly seem to understand ever: Everything about the universe When you die it stops hurting, and feels wonderful like the weight of the world has been taken off your shoulders.
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control
elements.Did you come to a border or point of no: I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will When I had the thought only I can control whether I live or die I returned to my body.
elements.What was your religion prior to your exp: Moderate Raised Catholic non practicing at this time
elements.Did you have a change in your values and: Yes Not afraid to die. Look forward to it. Disappointed I screwed it up by my thought.
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: The feelings of peace while out of body was the best.
elements.Have you ever shared this experience wit: Yes Disappointed with my new found desire to die.
